properties.description: TA-10.3 'Upload success low' (P1): upload.success_rate < 0.99 for 15 min. M0: no code-side emitter for upload.success_rate — this log-search rule over the closed events upload_started/upload_completed IS the alert (task file DECISION). Links to dashboard 'Upload funnel' (id 8ac05f38-5050-4c80-a55e-aad3f814f309, docs/dashboards/upload-funnel.json). dev: informational (launch traffic is synthetic)

allOf.query:
customEvents
| where name in ('upload_started', 'upload_completed') and timestamp >= ago(15m)
| summarize started = count_if(name == 'upload_started'), completed = count_if(name == 'upload_completed')
| extend successRate = 100.0 * completed / max(started, 1)
